## Summary
Describe what this change does and why.

## Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / packaging / CI

## Scope
- [ ] QML/Kirigami production UI
- [ ] Backend / helper
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Packaging / metadata
- [ ] Documentation / localization

## Verification
- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated
- [ ] Full CTest suite passes
- [ ] QML lint passes without warnings (when QML is changed)
- [ ] DEB/RPM build and package checks pass (when packaging/build inputs are changed)
- [ ] Documentation and translations updated where required

## Safety and compatibility
- [ ] No privileged operation was moved into the unprivileged GUI
- [ ] No unsupported legacy aliases or migration paths are introduced
- [ ] Current-version settings and runtime state remain safe across supported updates
- [ ] No secrets, generated build output, or unrelated changes are included

## Screenshots / logs
Add screenshots for UI changes and concise, redacted logs for relevant failures.
